title: fix(m157): restore the phone CGC streamed gate on staging (W5 regression)
body:
Restores the phone-side CGC streamed gate on staging. Regression: lspro-react #545 (phone flow) was cut from the 2026-08-25 head; the gate that made the 2026-08-27 phone walk work (a7b840c: cgc-gate phase pre-empting capture) never reached staging, so the 2026-09-02 walk produced no CGC page after the slab QR (walk defect W5, bdc-xo #1877).

What this ports: only `src/pages/GradedScanMobilePage.tsx` (cgc-gate phase + `CgcVerifyGate` mount in phone mode) and its test mocks. `CgcVerifyGate` and the `gradedScanSession` client functions are already on staging via #566 with every later fix; the `gradedScanFlag` import from the original commit is dropped (that file does not exist on staging; the tile is hardcoded on in this lineage).

Tests: `npx vitest run src/pages/GradedScanMobilePage.test.tsx src/components/ce/CgcVerifyGate.test.tsx` -> 73/73; `npx tsc --noEmit` exit 0.

Known, unchanged by this PR: after the click the stream is hidden and the batch runs unattended (the pre-#1889 behavior); #1889 (stream stays open, one click per new cert) builds on top of this. CGC provider enabled on staging Supabase (`grading_provider_config`) 2026-09-02 so the worker can act.

Reconcile-Skip: WO-LSPRO-M157-STREAM-STAYS-OPEN-UI-01
